h: The Black Country around Great Bridge
p: Great Bridge sits on the edge of Tipton, right in the heart of the Black Country, an area shaped by canals, coal and heavy industry.

The Black Country Living Museum, a short drive away on the Dudley side of Tipton, is a brilliant day out, with old shops, trams, a pub and costumed staff bringing the area's history to life. The canals around Tipton are great for a towpath walk too. Admiral itself is an adult gaming centre, which means strictly 18+. The Great Bridge shopping area has its retail park and a run of local shops, so you can grab a few bits while you're here, and there's no shortage of chippies nearby.
